SMS Relay is designed for an authorized, dedicated QA phone. It forwards newly received SMS messages according to the configuration you save.
The Google Chat webhook, relay mode, and most recent delivery result are stored in app-private storage on this device. The SMS body and OTP are not stored. Android backup is disabled.

When an incoming SMS qualifies under the saved relay mode, its receiving number, sender, timestamp, and complete original body are sent to the configured Google Chat webhook. All incoming messages mode can forward personal and unrelated SMS content.
SMS access receives new messages. Phone-number access is used only to identify the receiving SIM when available. Internet access sends qualifying messages to Google Chat.

The app does not scan SMS history, retain SMS bodies or OTPs, run analytics, or send background heartbeats. Clear app data or uninstall the app to remove its saved configuration and last relay status.
SMS access is required to relay incoming messages. Phone-number access is used only to identify the receiving SIM number when Android or the carrier provides it.
